proposition: A formal inquisitorial body (majlis-i tafaḥḥuṣ u dīvān-i tajassus) may have handled charges of heterodoxy, and presumably conducted Ibn Turka's three trials.

mediation.who: Muḥammad Ṭūsī, R. Majmaʿ al-Tahānī, written for Bāysunghur
mediation.note: refers to a body that interrogated Hurufis
'may have been' and 'presumably'; MK does not list the three trials on the pages read
